changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [reporting].[Metric_All] as select Al.AssetTypeUid, A.[Uid], V.Name, V.Description, A.ParentUid, A.IsGroup, V.Weight, V.EffectiveDate as MetricMaxEffectiveDate, ( select F.Name as FieldName, CI.Operator, CIV.Value, CIV.Value as ValueJson from [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] C inner join metrics.AssetVersionConditionItem CI on CI.AssetVersionConditionUid = C.Uid inner join FieldType F on F.ID = CI.ConditionFieldTypeID inner join metrics.AssetVersionConditionItemValue CIV on CIV.Uid = CI.Uid where C.AssetVersionUid = V.Uid for json path ) as ConditionsJson from metrics.AssetVersion V inner join metrics.Asset A on A.[Uid] = V.AssetUid inner join metrics.Allocation Al on Al.Uid = A.AllocationUid inner join ( select IA.[Uid], max(IV.EffectiveDate) as EffectiveDate from metrics.AssetVersion IV inner join metrics.Asset IA on IA.[Uid] = IV.AssetUid and IV.EffectiveDate <= getutcdate() and IA.State = 1 group by IA.[Uid] ) MV on MV.[Uid] = V.AssetUid AND MV.EffectiveDate = V.EffectiveDate GO
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Metric_All] AS select A.AssetTypeUid, A.[Uid], A.Name, A.ParentUid, A.IsGroup, V.Weight, V.EffectiveDate as MetricMaxEffectiveDate, ( select F.Name as FieldName, C.Operator, C.ValueJson from [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] C inner join FieldType F on F.ID = C.FieldTypeID where [Uid] = A.[Uid] and EffectiveDate = V.EffectiveDate for json path ) as ConditionsJson from metrics.AssetVersion V inner join metrics.Asset A on A.[Uid] = V.[Uid] inner join ( select IA.[Uid], max(IV.EffectiveDate) as EffectiveDate from metrics.AssetVersion IV inner join metrics.Asset IA on IA.[Uid] = IV.[Uid] and IV.EffectiveDate <= getutcdate() and IA.State = 1 group by IA.[Uid] ) MV on MV.[Uid] = V.[Uid] AND MV.EffectiveDate = V.EffectiveDate
